title: Sentences Begin in Same Cell

illustrates.quote: When a label is followed by more than one sentence, each sentence begins in cell 1.

blocks.text: Rewrite the sentences, inserting commas where needed.

items.text: **Example:** Ms. Ross are the seasons at the South Pole like ours?
<u>Ms. Ross, are the seasons at the South Pole like ours?</u>
7. No the seasons in Antarctica are the reverse of ours.
8. The continent as a matter of fact is like an enormous freezer.
